ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar May-29-2014 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled this day for OSC hearing for Name Change.
Dept. 514, Judge: Harry Dorfman, Clerk: M. Goodman, Court Reporter: Mitch Lyon, CSR #6840.
Petitioner Nga Tuyet Loi present in court.
Petitioner sworn and examined.
Proof of Publication on file.

Petitioner presents certified court records from San Mateo.
No objections to the proposed change of name were made at the hearing.
It appears to the satisfaction of the Court that all the allegations in the petition are true, correct and sufficient, and the petition should be granted.
The court grants the petition for Change of Name to Miriam Loi.
Decree Changing Name signed in open court.

ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Apr-03-2014 Reset To May-29-14 At 09:00 A.M. In Dept 514 For Order To Show Cause

Petitioner Nga Tuyet Loi sworn and examined through Vietnamese Interpreter Frances Samael.
Proof of Publication on file.

Court ordered matter continued to at 9:00 AM, in Department 514. Petitioner to bring proof/official record that probation in San Mateo is over.
